detail.longDescription:
Web developers, you'd probably lose your payments for this, but any time a marketing person wants something on the website, tell them no.

I just visited a client’s website I couldn't access because there were 6 dialogs that begged me to join their fucking mailing list, a site I will never visit again.

I thought marketing wasn't supposed to be about this stupid web ruining garbage. Whatever happened to them getting reviews and hosting events instead of sticking their nose in web development.

Ugh. Maybe we should make tech more difficult so these goblins can't fuck up a perfectly good Ecommerce website.

I explained why those modals were a barrier and the marketing dude argued with me that it generates leads and subscribers. Bullshit. You can't tell me anybody willingly registered to your list after being digitally assaulted like that.

#WebDev #Business
